name: Stains of Blue
source:
STAINS OF BLUE is an erotic visual novel that explores the many shades of the Netorase fetish.

Guide your heroine through unique stories shaped by the personality you choose. Select from 5 unique shades of blue each with their own unique personality and their own story to tell: from the tender and devoted hue of Aquamarine to the vivid and commanding color of Cobalt.
